gloss: next life; afterlife; world to come

definitions.gloss: next life; afterlife; world to come
definitions.explanation: The life one is believed to live after death, according to Buddhist concepts of reincarnation. Also used casually in everyday speech to express wishes for a future existence.

examples.japanese: {来世|らいせ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれたい→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: In my next life, I want to be born as a bird.
I hope we can meet again in the next life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現世|げんせ}→現世：20421_gense⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{来世|らいせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, it is believed that one's actions in this life determine one's fate in the next life.

notes:
A Buddhist term that has entered everyday Japanese. A compound of {来|らい} (coming, next) and {世|せ} (world, life). Part of a set of three:
- ⟦{前世|ぜんせ}→前世：14987_zense⟧ (previous life)
- ⟦{現世|げんせ}→現世：20421_gense⟧ (this life, present world)
- {来世|らいせ} (next life, afterlife)

In casual conversation, {来世|らいせ} is often used lightheartedly to express a wish for a different existence, without serious religious meaning.

Also read as らいせい in some Buddhist texts, but らいせ is the standard modern reading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あの{世|よ}→あの世：10214_anoyo⟧ means 'the other world' / afterlife (not reincarnation-focused)
- ⟦{天国|てんごく}→天国：27976_tengoku⟧ means heaven

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来世|らいせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (to believe in an afterlife)
- {来世|らいせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれ{変|か}わる→生まれ変わる：13522_umarekawaru⟧ (to be reborn in the next life)
- {来世|らいせ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even in the next life)
